Dear Sirs, 
 
Sub: Listing of Equity Shares of Jio Platforms Limited  
 
 
This is further to our disclosure dated October 24, 2026 intimating about the filing of the Prospectus 
dated October 24, 2026 by Jio Platforms Limited (JPL), a subsidiary of the Company for the Initial 
Public Offer by way of a fresh issue of up to 27,00,00,000 (Twenty seven crore) equity shares of 
face value of ₹10 each (“IPO”). 
 
JPL has, on October 26, 2026, completed allotment of equity shares to the successful applicants 
in various categories  and has today, i.e., October 27, 2026, received final listing and trading 
approval from the stock exchanges . T he trading in equity shares of JPL will commence from 
Wednesday, October 28, 2026. 
 
Further, JPL has, vide its letter dated October 27, 2026, also informed the Company that a meeting 
of board of directors of JPL is scheduled to be held on Friday, October 30, 2026, inter alia, to 
consider and approve the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results of JPL for the 
quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. 
 
Letter received from JPL is attached. 
 
This is for information and record. 
 
Thanking you  
Yours faithfully,  
For Reliance Industries Limited
